scope: Survivorship-aware Spot-long profitability research only; no strategy implemented.
basis: Verified 1h, 4h, and 1d official Spot archive samples with SHA-256 companions.
A point-in-time Binance liquidity universe can use trailing archive facts without current-universe look-ahead.
lifecycle_evidence: Two full Spot delistings and two Spot migrations are now corroborated by official Binance announcements and checksum-verified archive observations. Archive 404s remain supporting absence observations only.
limitations: Market-cap top-N is not accepted for the low-cost first pass: official CoinGecko historical access and inactive-asset mapping are keyed/plan-constrained.
Klines do not supply historical spread, depth, or price impact.
Archive absence alone cannot establish a delisting.
Point-in-time token-level Sharia status cannot be reconstructed from current project sources.
planned_mitigations: Use trailing liquidity, listing-age, and completeness filters.
Maintain a sourced lifecycle table and never stitch migrations without demonstrated economic continuity.
Keep broad-universe research non-execution-eligible until a manually reviewed stable allowlist exists.
